result.rationale: parseRefreshTokenResponse explicitly fabricates a placeholder: `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing. With credential sharing enabled (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT), the loose minimumTokenResponseSchema only requires access_token (and a numeric expiry), so responses lacking refresh_token get the fake string, and callers (e.g. GoogleCalendarService then prisma.credential.update with `data: { key }`, Zoom/O365 similar paths) persist it, clobbering real refresh tokens and breaking future refreshes. The mechanism is verifiable

judged_text: The helper fabricates a literal 'refresh_token' placeholder string and callers persist it to the DB whenever the (loose) minimumTokenResponseSchema response lacks refresh_token, changing the stored credential schema. With credential sharing enabled, the sync endpoint's response (access_token + expiry only) causes every refreshed credential in Google/O365/Zoom paths to have key.refresh_token overwritten with the fake string 'refresh_token'; if sync is later disabled, all those credentials attempt to refresh with a junk refresh token and permanently fail, requiring re-auth.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, when credential sharing is enabled it validates against `minimumTokenResponseSchema` and then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` if missing. This mutated value can then be persisted. For example, in `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenResponse = parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` and then `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` will overwrite `refresh_token` with the literal placeholder and later update the credential in Prisma, corrupting stored credentials if the sync/refresh response doesn’t include a real refresh token. That matches the finding’s failure mode when sync is later disabled.
